title: asclepias tuberosa var. rolfsii
intro: Asclepias tuberosa var. rolfsii, commonly known as Butterfly Weed, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Apocynaceae family. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, making it useful in the treatment of various health conditions. The therapeutic actions of Butterfly Weed include wound healing, pain relief, and the treatment of respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma. The bioactive constituents of this plant include cardenolides, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
